kevin: quick idea  add an escape-hatch for pinned models: control-plane can mark pins to phase out and ops can force-unpin if canary regresses. thoughts?

anya: +1. schema vs action question?

kevin: both. metadata to nudge clients, API for manual override. example fields: pinned_until, phase_out_ts, phase_out_reason, grace_window_seconds, kv_invalidate_hint.

rachit: need runtime signal for KV cache. soft phase-out might leave stale KV -> add kv_invalidate_hint (immediate|ttl|none).

lila: telemetry is critical: emit pin.phase_out and pin.force_unpin with rollout id, actor, before/after refs.

ops-bot: deploybot: canary rl-2026-05-11-09 started for tenant=acme :eyes:

anya: also: compat_fallbacks list so runtime can pick a safe variant instead of full revert.

rachit: fallback must include constraints (max_seq_len, vocab_hash, quant_bits) to avoid silent quality drops.

lila: RBAC for force_unpin. require rollback_justification, support dry_run.

kevin: also cooldown after auto-phase to avoid accidental flip-flops. 10m?

rachit: client semantics: on phase_out clients should migrate over grace_window; after pinned_until return PIN_EXPIRED + suggested_alternatives.

lila: force_unpin must trigger resource rebind; response include rebind_required flag. ops: expect capacity spike.

kevin: observability event shape: flat fields: event_type, pin_id, old_model_ref, new_model_ref|null, actor, reason, rollout_id, kv_invalidation, affected_tenants_count.

anya: record pre_release_sha for reproducible evals.

rachit: plan: add fields to pin object, runtime honor kv hint & fallbacks, admin API force_unpin with audit, telemetry + alerts. feature-flag rollout.

lila: tests: chaos test flipping phase_out during canary, load test for immediate rebind.

kevin: tradeoff: keep surface small. include op_hints opaque blob for advanced operators.

rachit: naming: prefer phase_out over deprecate. less ambiguous.

kevin: ok I'll draft RFC follow-up with sample API contract. no objections by EOD -> PR behind flag.

anya: SGTM.

ops-bot: deploybot: oncall pinged for potential rebind spikes :warning:
